label: Bãi giữ xe RFID - Nhóm 4
info:
Tầng 3 (Middleware) và Tầng 4 (Application).

ESP32 là nguồn dữ liệu gốc về ô đỗ và barie; Node-RED đồng bộ qua MQTT, chạy 4 rule, ghi log và hiển thị dashboard.

format:
<style>
.pk-wrap{font-family:'Segoe UI',Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;color:#e2e8f0;height:100%;box-sizing:border-box}
.pk-muted{color:#94a3b8}
.pk-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;height:100%}
.pk-kpi{background:#0f172a;border:1px solid #1e293b;border-left:4px solid #38bdf8;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;min-width:0}
.pk-kpi.ok{border-left-color:#22c55e}.pk-kpi.warn{border-left-color:#f59e0b}.pk-kpi.danger{border-left-color:#ef4444}
.pk-kpi-head{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.6px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#94a3b8;font-weight:600}
.pk-kpi-head .fa{margin-right:6px;color:#38bdf8}
.pk-kpi-value{font-size:28px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;white-space:nowrap}
.pk-kpi-value small{font-size:15px;color:#94a3b8;font-weight:600}
.pk-kpi-value.txt{font-size:16px}
.pk-kpi-sub{font-size:12px;color:#cbd5e1;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.pk-bar{height:6px;background:#1e293b;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}
.pk-bar div{height:100%;background:#38bdf8;transition:width .4s}
.pk-kpi.danger .pk-bar div{background:#ef4444}
.pk-dot{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:8px;vertical-align:middle;background:#ef4444;box-shadow:0 0 8px #ef4444}
.pk-dot.on{background:#22c55e;box-shadow:0 0 8px #22c55e}
.pk-slots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;height:100%}
.pk-slot{position:relative;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;text-align:center;border:2px dashed #22c55e;background:rgba(34,197,94,.06);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;transition:all .3s}
.pk-slot.busy{border:2px solid #38bdf8;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#0c2a4a,#0f172a)}
.pk-slot.late{border-color:#f59e0b;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3a2606,#0f172a)}
.pk-slot-id{position:absolute;top:8px;left:12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#94a3b8;letter-spacing:.5px}
.pk-slot-empty{color:#22c55e;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px}
.pk-slot-empty .fa{font-size:34px;display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
.pk-slot .fa-motorcycle{font-size:30px;color:#38bdf8;margin-bottom:4px}
.pk-slot.late .fa-motorcycle{color:#f59e0b}
.pk-plate{display:inline-block;font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;background:#f8fafc;color:#0f172a;border-radius:4px;padding:2px 10px;margin:4px auto 6px;border:2px solid #334155}
.pk-line{font-size:12px;color:#cbd5e1;line-height:1.5}
.pk-timer{margin-top:4px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#e2e8f0}
.pk-tag{position:absolute;top:8px;right:10px;background:#f59e0b;color:#111827;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px}
.pk-banner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;background:rgba(34,197,94,.12);border:1px solid #166534;transition:all .3s}
.pk-banner .fa{font-size:24px;color:#22c55e;width:26px;text-align:center}
.pk-banner.lv-warn{background:rgba(245,158,11,.14);border-color:#b45309}.pk-banner.lv-warn .fa{color:#f59e0b}
.pk-banner.lv-danger{background:rgba(239,68,68,.16);border-color:#b91c1c}.pk-banner.lv-danger .fa{color:#ef4444}
.pk-banner.lv-info{background:rgba(56,189,248,.12);border-color:#0369a1}.pk-banner.lv-info .fa{color:#38bdf8}
.pk-banner-title{font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
.pk-banner-text{font-size:12px;color:#cbd5e1}
.pk-gate{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-top:12px;padding:10px 14px;background:#0f172a;border:1px solid #1e293b;border-radius:10px}
.pk-scene{position:relative;width:120px;height:70px;flex:none}
.pk-post{position:absolute;left:8px;bottom:6px;width:14px;height:44px;background:#475569;border-radius:3px}
.pk-arm{position:absolute;left:15px;bottom:42px;width:100px;height:8px;border-radius:4px;transform-origin:4px 50%;transition:transform .6s ease;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#ef4444 0 14px,#f8fafc 14px 28px)}
.pk-arm.open{transform:rotate(-80deg)}
.pk-road{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:6px;background:#334155;border-radius:3px}
.pk-lights{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.pk-light{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:#1e293b;border:1px solid #334155}
.pk-light.red.on{background:#ef4444;box-shadow:0 0 10px #ef4444}
.pk-light.green.on{background:#22c55e;box-shadow:0 0 10px #22c55e}
.pk-gate-state{font-size:18px;font-weight:700}
.pk-gate-sub{font-size:12px;color:#cbd5e1;line-height:1.6}
.pk-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px}
.pk-table th{text-align:left;color:#94a3b8;font-weight:600;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #1e293b}
.pk-table td{padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #162033;white-space:nowrap}
.pk-table td:last-child{white-space:normal;color:#cbd5e1}
.pk-table tr:first-child td{animation:pkflash 1.2s ease}
@keyframes pkflash{from{background:rgba(56,189,248,.18)}to{background:transparent}}
.pk-mono{font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-weight:600}
.pk-badge{display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;border:1px solid}
.pk-badge.ok{color:#4ade80;border-color:#166534;background:rgba(34,197,94,.1)}
.pk-badge.info{color:#7dd3fc;border-color:#0369a1;background:rgba(56,189,248,.1)}
.pk-badge.warn{color:#fbbf24;border-color:#b45309;background:rgba(245,158,11,.1)}
.pk-badge.danger{color:#f87171;border-color:#b91c1c;background:rgba(239,68,68,.12)}
.pk-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;height:100%}
.pk-stat{background:#0f172a;border:1px solid #1e293b;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px}
.pk-stat b{display:block;font-size:20px;margin-top:2px}
.pk-stat span{font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}
.pk-dbnote{display:flex;align-items:center;height:100%;font-size:12px;color:#94a3b8;padding:0 4px}
.pk-dbnote .fa{margin-right:8px;color:#38bdf8;flex:none}
.pk-dbnote code{background:#1e293b;color:#7dd3fc;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-size:11px;margin:0 2px}
@media (max-width:760px){.pk-kpis,.pk-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
md-toast .md-toast-content{font-family:'Segoe UI',Roboto,Arial,sans-serif}
</style>
